post.summary: Add a line to a draft invoice
post.description: Appends a line to a Draft invoice. Lines can only be changed while the invoice is a draft, and the line currency must match the invoice currency; both are rejected with a 409/400 problem document rather than an exception. Send If-Match with the ETag from GET to act only on the version you read: a stale one is a 412 and changes nothing.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique value per logical request; a retry repeats the request with the same key. Scoped to the caller, the method and the route. A retry of a completed request is answered with the original status, body and Location plus `Idempotency-Replayed: true`; the same key with a different method, path or body is a 422; a retry while the first request is still running is a 409 with Retry-After. A failed request leaves no reservation, so its key may be retried as is. Responses larger than 65536 bytes are not stored: a retry of such a request is a 409 (Idempotency.Duplicate) and the resource must be read instead. Omit the header to send the request without idempotency. A blank value, a repeated header or a comma-separated list is a 400 (Idempotency.InvalidKey).

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The `ETag` from `GET` of the version this write may act on: one strong tag, or `*` for any. Omitted, the write is unconditional. A version that is no longer current, a weak tag, a list or a value this API never issued answers 412 and changes nothing.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: `true` when this response is the stored outcome of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key, not a new execution. Absent otherwise.

400.description: Validation failed or the request could not be read; `errors[]` names each offending field (`field` is null for a whole-request error).

403.description: Authenticated, but lacking the required permission.

409.description: Idempotency-Key conflict: the first request with this key is still running (`Idempotency.InFlight`, retry after `Retry-After`), or it completed but its response cannot be replayed (`Idempotency.Duplicate`: read the resource). The resource is not in a state that allows this operation, or it changed concurrently.

412.description: Precondition failed: the resource changed since the `If-Match` version; reload it and decide again.

422.description: This Idempotency-Key was already used for a different request — another method, path or body (`Idempotency.FingerprintMismatch`).

429.description: Rate limit exceeded; `Retry-After` says when to retry.

500.description: Unexpected failure; quote `correlationId` or `traceId` when reporting it.

get.summary: Get one invoice with its lines
get.description: Returns one invoice with its lines and computed total. Responses are served through the read cache, which every write on the same invoice invalidates. The ETag is the version a write may name in If-Match.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: ETag(s) from a previous response (weak or strong form, a comma-separated list, or `*`); a match answers 304 with no body.

304.description: Not modified: an `If-None-Match` value matched the current ETag.

CreateInvoiceRequest.description: Wire contracts for the Invoices feature — shared verbatim by the API host and its clients (the Blazor web UI, tests).

field.description:
JSON path of the offending request member (e.g. `customerName`, `lines[0].amount`), or
null when the failure is about the request as a whole.

description.description: Human sentence describing the failure; safe to show to the user.

FieldError.description: One failure inside a 400 ProblemResponse: a validation failure, or a body value of the wrong type (`Request.InvalidValue`).

InvoiceDto.description: One invoice with its lines. `Version` is the row version behind the strong `ETag` of `GET /invoices/{id}`, which a write may send back as `If-Match`: opaque, monotonic per invoice.

InvoiceStatus.description:
Lifecycle state of an invoice, serialised by name (`"Issued"`) so the document declares a string
enum and clients get a type instead of a free string. Mirrors the domain's `InvoiceStatus`
member for member; an architecture test keeps the two equal (ADR-0025).

PagedResponseOfInvoiceDto.description: A page of results returned to clients, with the metadata to render paging controls.

title.description: Short human summary of the problem class. Not for branching.

status.description: The HTTP status code the server set.

detail.description: Human explanation of this occurrence; safe to show to the user on a 4xx.

instance.description: The request path the problem occurred on.

correlationId.description: The same value as the `X-Correlation-ID` response header.

traceId.description: W3C trace id of the request.

errors.description: The individual failures of a 400: each validation failure, or the body member whose value had the wrong type.

ProblemResponse.description: RFC 9457 problem document (ADR-0024): every 4xx/5xx response. Branch on `code` (`type` is `urn:problem-type:{code}`); `title` and `detail` are for people; `errors[]` is present on a 400 produced from a Result and on a 400 whose body held a value of the wrong type (`Request.InvalidValue`), absent otherwise; `correlationId` equals the X-Correlation-ID response header.

Bearer.description: Access token from POST /auth/login; rotate via POST /auth/refresh.
